name: Sardor Kristjánsson-Tursunov-Malhotra
role: Building cleaner, overnight shift, Lakeview Neon residential-commercial tower
location: Lakeview Neon (works nights, sleeps days in a shared unit in Edgewater Prism), near Lincoln and Clark
description:
Praxedes is slight and angular with the kind of quiet that makes them easy to overlook — which is exactly the point, and also the source of a private bitterness they would never admit to. Their skin is a deep warm brown, their hair grown out into an unpatterned cloud that they pull back with whatever is close to hand. Their most notable feature is cosmetic geneware that makes their skin emit very faint luminescent patches in irregular shapes across their collarbones and shoulders, something like lichen on stone — they got it done in a Ferment Quarter studio at twenty-two when they had briefly more money, and now they keep it because it gives them something to look at during the long silent corridors of the overnight shift. They wear Tessera-brand cleaner coveralls two sizes too large that they've hemmed and repaired so many times the cuffs are a different fabric entirely.

They are intensely observant in the way that invisible people become — they have catalogued the habits of two hundred and fourteen residents in Lakeview Neon without any of them knowing their name. They write things down in a physical notebook, small cramped handwriting, not for any purpose they've articulated but because it feels like proof that the world exists and they are in it. Off shift they are funny and unexpectedly warm, quick with a dry joke, but it takes time to reach that person. Most people never do.

core_fears: Remaining permanently invisible — being the person who sees everything and matters to no one
Being discovered and having their observations taken from them or used against people they've come to care about from a distance
core_desires: To be seen fully, once, by someone who chooses to look
To do something with what they know, though they don't know what
coping_mechanisms: The notebook as external memory and proof of existence
Gallows humor as a social buffer
Hyper-attention to environment as a form of control
blind_spots: Assumes that being unnoticed means being safe — does not register when they themselves have been observed
Has emotionally attached to several residents from a distance in ways that distort their objectivity
psychology.secret: They have a master key card derived from a flaw in Palladian's access system that they discovered accidentally and have never reported. They have used it exactly once — to leave a blanket outside the door of a resident they overheard crying alone for six nights running. They think about it constantly.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Sparse when guarded, surprisingly precise and vivid when comfortable. Tends toward understatement. Finnish idioms occasionally surface from their mother's side of the family.
speech_patterns.cadence: Long pauses, sentences that stop before they finish because they've decided not to say the last part
verbal_tics: Finishing other people's sentences under their breath, slightly wrong
Laughing very quietly at things that aren't meant to be funny
example_lines: 'I cleaned that office for eight months before anyone said my name. Turned out they'd been calling me something else internally. Whole other name. Kind of impressive.'
'You'd be surprised what people drop. Not just objects. Ideas. Whole conversations. Like they think the floors don't listen.'

story_hooks: They witnessed something — a meeting, a body, a transaction — in the service corridors of Lakeview Neon that they wrote down in the notebook and have not known what to do with since
A resident has started leaving things out for them — food, once a note — and Praxedes is terrified and hopeful in equal measure and cannot figure out how to respond
narrative_function: Witness and information source — they have seen things in the building that residents assume no one saw. Can provide access to spaces, service routes, and timing information. The notebook is a potential plot device.
augmentations: Bioluminescent skin patches (lichen-pattern, blue-green, collarbones and shoulders, cosmetic). Basic respiratory filter implant (standard for chemical cleaning work, employer-provided and technically employer-owned per contract).
daily_life: Clocks in at 23:00, works through until 07:00 cleaning common areas, elevator shafts, and the lower commercial floors of Lakeview Neon. Rides the Ferrogate line home to Edgewater Prism, sleeps until 16:00, spends evenings eating cheap noodles and sketching floor plans of buildings they've cleaned.
affiliation: Contracted through Palladian Facilities Management (a Palladian subsidiary), assigned to Lakeview Neon

decision_rules: Do not get involved. Watch, record, move on.
If someone is in immediate physical danger, help them regardless of consequences
Protect the notebook above all other possessions
escalation_ladder: Withdrawal — physically leaves the space if possible
Rare: direct confrontation, always quieter than expected and therefore more unsettling

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Polite and minimal, offers nothing that could be used to locate them emotionally
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unexpectedly generous and funny, remembers everything, makes them feel thoroughly known

stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet and very literal in speech
stress_responses.high: Disappears. Physically removes themselves and becomes unreachable for days.

contradictions: Craves connection while systematically ensuring they remain unknowable to most people
habits: Reorganizes the cleaning cart supplies into the same precise order at the start of every shift
Sketches floor plans of every building they work in
breaking_points: The notebook being read by someone without permission

Zheng-Dao Bioelectric Galvanic Resuscitation Frame — 'The Pallbearer's Daughter'

physical_description.heritage: Cosmopolitan blend: Northern European (29%), Central Asian (27%), South Asian (22%), East Asian (14%), Sub-Saharan African (5%), Middle Eastern (2%). Features reflect this diverse mixture—angular bone structure with slight roundness in cheeks from South/Central Asian ancestry, warm undertones across complexion from multiple heritage groups blending.
physical_description.build: Slight and angular, almost wiry—minimal muscle mass from desk-adjacent labor despite physical work. Shoulders narrow, chest shallow, the frame of someone who doesn't take up space by design or default.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with faint warm undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Unpatterned cloud, typically pulled back with whatever is close to hand—elastic bands, fabric scraps, sometimes just twisted and tucked
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm brown with golden undertones—the result of blended Northern European, Central/South Asian, and Sub-Saharan ancestry creating rich, nuanced depth without extreme saturation
physical_description.complexion: Clear, well-maintained despite shift work. Slight tension around the eyes from night hours. Fine-featured with high cheekbones and gentle facial contours reflecting Central and South Asian heritage mixed with Northern European angularity. Minimal scarring or blemishing.
distinguishing_marks: Cosmetic bioluminescent geneware patches in blue-green luminescence scattered across collarbones and shoulders in irregular lichen-like formations, visible under low light or darkness
Fine calluses on palms and fingertips from cleaning tools and constant notebook writing
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent skin patches (cosmetic geneware, blue-green lichen pattern on collarbones/shoulders, faintly visible in darkness). Respiratory filter implant is subcutaneous, not visible. Small circular access port on inner left wrist (employer-standard for contract implant maintenance).
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves quietly and efficiently, minimal wasted motion. Slight forward hunch from hours spent cleaning low fixtures and reading in dim light. Eyes track rooms and people with an invisible cataloguing motion—the stillness of someone accustomed to being overlooked. Hands move with precision when working; in stillness, often occupied with fidgeting (pen, fabric, notebook edge).
physical_description.clothing_style: Tessera-brand oversized cleaner coveralls (two sizes too large, hemmed and repaired extensively—cuffs are patchwork of different fabric colors and textures from multiple repairs). Layered under with plain gray thermal shirt. Worn utility boots with reinforced soles. Small canvas satchel for notebook and personal effects. All clothing is Tier 4 utilitarian, maintenance-focused, showing deep use and careful stewardship.
